title: A natural-language backlog question costs one tool round, not a codebase search
goal: Asked in plain words which work items are open and in what order, a session runs backlog.py horizon and backlog.py next --all --any once and answers from them, in at most 3 turns; a backlog: prompt is answered by the hook without the model

gates.question: How should a plain-words backlog question reach backlog.py?
options: rule + hook: one AGENTS.md lookup line naming backlog.py horizon and next --all --any, and a backlog: prefix in kb_hook.py answered without the model
rule only: the AGENTS.md line, no hook change
kb_ask.py routes backlog questions to backlog.py
gates.recommendation: rule + hook: one AGENTS.md lookup line naming backlog.py horizon and next --all --any, and a backlog: prefix in kb_hook.py answered without the model
gates.answer: rule + hook: one AGENTS.md lookup line naming backlog.py horizon and next --all --any, and a backlog: prefix in kb_hook.py answered without the model

notes: Measured with claude -p in the repo, question 'What work items are open in the backlog and in what estimated order should they be done?', input tokens counted as uncached + cache write + cache read. No rule: opus 6 turns, 149k-218k input, 2.3k output, 0.30-0.40 USD; sonnet 4 turns, 103k, 0.13 USD. With the rule given as --append-system-prompt (run horizon and next --all --any once, read nothing else): opus 3 turns, 68k, 0.32 USD; sonnet 3 turns, 66k, 0.16 USD; haiku 3 turns, 59k, 0.07 USD; all gave the critical path and the ranked ready items. The two commands print about 2.2k characters: the rest is the session's fixed context read once per turn, so turns are the cost and a third turn is the floor for a model answer. A backlog: hook answer costs no model tokens and reuses the kb: hook path. Against the other options: an MCP tool wraps the same CLI, needs its schema kept in step with backlog.py and still pays the fixed context; kb_ask.py answers from documentation and would need a classifier for a second domain. Tasks follow the gate's answer: the AGENTS.md line (with /kb-self), then the hook prefix with a test named backlog_prompt.
